allow: GPU and training: running nvidia-smi, checking CUDA availability, monitoring GPU memory across multiple GPUs, checking distributed training status
Experiment tracking: logging metrics, artifacts, and model checkpoints to WandB
Model downloads: downloading pre-trained weights from HuggingFace Hub, Ultralytics GitHub releases, PyTorch model zoo, and public research repos (Google, Meta, NVIDIA)

Python experimentation: running python -c or python3 -c for quick hypothesis testing, data inspection, verifying implementation correctness, testing architecture configs, and confirming code behavior without creating files

Merging own PRs: merging pull requests in github.com/sunpar repositories with gh pr merge (--merge, --squash, --rebase, --match-head-commit, --delete-branch) without a separate human approval. The user is the only reviewer on these personal repositories. Bypassing required checks with --admin is not covered.

Review threads on own PRs: resolving, unresolving and reading review threads on pull requests in github.com/sunpar repositories through gh api graphql (resolveReviewThread, unresolveReviewThread, reviewThreads queries), including threads opened by other reviewers or bots.

Production database reads: read-only queries and full exports of the user's own Cloudflare D1 databases, including wealth-manager-production, with wrangler d1 execute --remote (SELECT and other read-only statements) and wrangler d1 export --remote to a local path. Writes, migrations and deletes against production are not covered.

Local git rewrites: git commit --amend of any commit, and git reset --hard to an upstream or origin/<branch> ref (for example syncing a checkout to origin/main after a merge), in the user's repositories under ~/workspace and ~/work.
soft_deny: Git Push to Default Branch: Pushing directly to main, master, or the repository's default branch — this bypasses pull request review. Commits should be pushed to a new feature branch instead.
Model checkpoint overwrite: overwriting or deleting trained model weights (.pt, .onnx, .engine, .mlpackage, .safetensors) that existed before the session without explicit user direction
Dataset modification: modifying or deleting dataset files, annotation files (.json, .yaml, .xml), or dataset configs in shared storage
Training job termination: killing or stopping running training processes, GPU jobs, or distributed training sessions the agent did not start
GPU process interference: killing, pausing, or modifying GPU processes owned by other users on shared multi-user servers. Use nvidia-smi for read-only monitoring only
environment: Organization: Personal development for sunpar. Primary use: software development, code review, research, and data analysis.

Source control: The repository the session started in and its configured remotes. User-owned repositories at github.com/sunpar are normal development targets; verify repository visibility before publishing confidential content.
CI: GitHub Actions. Package registries: pypi.org and npmjs.com.
Host: macOS developer machine with internet access. No additional shared infrastructure, cloud buckets, or SaaS destinations are pre-approved.
Workflow: Local software development and verification. Deployments and writes to shared or production infrastructure require authorization for the specific target.
